task.title: Fix TreeDataProvider getParent method for find task reveal
task.description: The Find Task command in the VSCode extension throws an error when selecting a task from the quick pick. The error states: "Required registered TreeDataProvider to implement 'getParent' method to access 'reveal' method." This prevents users from navigating to tasks via search.
task.problem: The Find Task command successfully searches and displays tasks in a quick pick, but selecting a task throws an error because the TreeDataProvider doesn't implement the required getParent() method. VSCode's TreeView.reveal() API requires getParent to traverse the tree hierarchy and locate the item to reveal.
task.value: Users can use the Find Task feature to quickly locate and reveal tasks in the Kanban View tree, improving navigation efficiency especially in large task boards with many items.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a user invokes the Find Task command (kanban.findTask) And they search for and select a task from the quick pick results When the selection is confirmed Then the task should be revealed and highlighted in the Kanban View tree And no error should be thrown
Given the Kanban View TreeDataProvider When the getParent method is called with a task item Then it should return the parent column item And when called with a column item Then it should return undefined (root level)
